candidate.answerReason: You and five friends make six fundraisers. Dividing 1500 dollars equally among six people gives 250 dollars each.

methods.label: Divide among all six people
methods.explanation:
Include yourself when counting the fundraisers: there are \(1+5=6\) people. Dividing the total equally gives
\[
1500\div6=250.
\]
Each person needs to raise \(\boxed{250}\) dollars, choice \(\text{A}\).
methods.levelReason: Counting the participants and applying equal-sharing division suffice.

candidate.annotationRationale: The task assesses modeling an equal allocation with division. The meaning of division as equal sharing directly supports the written method.
